How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The core of this infrastructure is the NOWPayments gateway, which integrates with popular cryptocurrencies like Bitcoin and Ethereum. This allows creators to accept payments directly from their customers, without relying on third-party platforms. The transaction data is then stored in a secure database, providing a transparent and tamper-proof record of all transactions. This architecture is designed to be highly scalable and flexible, making it suitable for creators who want to grow their business quickly.
